segments.title: 第118章 搖滾社
segments.content:
Reigniting the Verdant Years Chapter 118 The Rock Club

Among the parents, even in just a few short hours, they would quickly form their own little cliques.

While touring the school, the parents of Class 8 had already separated into three or four distinct circles.

Among them, the circle led by Li Guohong was the largest by far.

A dozen or so parents enthusiastically gathered around Li Guohong, showering him with praise at every turn, seeking his advice on how to raise children.

Li Guohong knew his own limits; he had no idea how Li Luo had suddenly become so impressive. So, he could only offer some motivational clichés over and over.

But even so, whatever Li Guohong said was treated as a golden rule in the eyes of the other parents, something to be studied with the utmost sincerity.

It was just that everyone had already heard or read the same principles countless times. The only difference was the person saying them, which produced a completely different effect.

"My Xiuxiu often mentions our class president at home, saying that when she was the class president, she always felt she was doing a great job," Xiuxiu's parent said from within the group. "But ever since she saw how Li Luo does it, she realized she still has a lot to learn."

"Our child is about the same," said Xu Yinghuan's parent. "She often praises how capable the class president is at home, and now I finally see it for myself."

"Isn't that the truth," Jin Yuting's parent couldn't help but add. "You might not know this, but our Tingting was in the same class as Li Luo back in middle school."

"Back then, Li Luo's grades were pretty average. But guess what? He astounded everyone in the high school entrance exams, ranking 86th in the whole district!"

"This time, he even ranked 27th in our entire No. 1 Affiliated High School. You can only say that boys are just a bit mischievous and playful when they're younger. Once they get that drive to study, there's really no stopping them."

Immersed in such an atmosphere, it was truly difficult for Li Guohong not to smile. He could only try his best to keep his smile from becoming overly smug, maintaining a modest and decent demeanor.

Apart from this central circle, the other parents of Class 8 formed several smaller groups.

Some parents were simply more introverted by nature, so they just quietly followed Xiuxiu, who was introducing the school. This group also had about a dozen people.

Some parents didn't like to flatter others, so they walked off to the side, chatting casually now and then, mainly just looking around.

There were also those like Yuan Wanqing, who stood out by walking alone, seriously observing the school. After all, this was also her first time at No. 1 Affiliated High School. Even when school started, Yan Zhusheng had come to register by himself.

And then there were those like Zhang Xuefen, who simply couldn't stand Li Guohong's smug look.

The thought of Li Luo ranking 27th in the whole school while her son only ranked in the three hundreds left a bitter taste in her mouth.

Back in middle school, Li Luo had been far behind Wei Chun.

During the New Year family visits every year, Zhang Xuefen had teased Lin Xiuhong about this quite a bit.

Fortunately, it was Li Guohong who came to Li Luo's parent-teacher conference today. Otherwise, Zhang Xuefen could just imagine the look on Lin Xiuhong's face in front of her.

It was sickening just to think about it.

However, seeing Li Guohong basking in the limelight over there, Zhang Xuefen couldn't help but inch closer.

Once everyone was tired of the flattery and began to genuinely admire the school's scenery, Zhang Xuefen seized the opportunity, sidled up to Li Guohong, and said with feigned nonchalance:

"Li Guohong, I heard you bought a school district apartment nearby, right? That must have cost a pretty penny, right?"

Li Guohong, who had been in a good mood, frowned upon hearing Zhang Xuefen's sudden remark. "Yes, it's more convenient for our child to get to school. It's quite good."

He didn't know why Zhang Xuefen kept bringing this up. She had already chattered on about it when they had just entered the school gate.

As expected, Zhang Xuefen continued, "That's an expense of nearly two million yuan right off the bat. The pressure can't be small. Your family's breakfast shop is hard work as it is. You should remind Xiuhong to take care of her health."

Sure enough, upon hearing that Li Guohong's family ran a breakfast shop, the expressions of some parents flickered, becoming somewhat different.

People were always like that.

When someone was better than them in one aspect, it was fine to offer polite compliments. But if they were stronger than the other person in another aspect, they could find some comfort in their hearts.

The parents present were all from well-to-do families.

In terms of income, they might not differ much from a breakfast shop.

But a breakfast shop sounded like manual labor. The social standing was immediately different.

But just then, Shao Heqi's father, who was standing to the side, suddenly looked at Li Guohong with interest and asked curiously, "Did your family buy a place nearby because you heard some news?"

"Hm?" Li Guohong was feeling a little down because of Zhang Xuefen's words. Hearing the question from Shao Heqi's father, he couldn't help but be taken aback. "What news are you referring to?"

"I wouldn't have dared to say it before, but now..." Shao Heqi's father chuckled. "The city recently released a draft plan for the ninth phase of the Yuhang City subway. It looks like the subway line will be extended over here in our Yinjiang District."

"I heard the rumors earlier, so I deliberately bought an apartment near here last year."

"After all, No. 1 Affiliated High School has its own dormitories. I was thinking, unless your family paid in full, you probably wouldn't have been so set on buying an apartment right here."

Li Guohong looked at him with some surprise and couldn't help but ask, "Excuse me, which student's parent are you?"

"Oh, I forgot to mention," Shao Heqi's father extended his hand to shake his, chuckling, "I'm Shao Heqi's father. Our children were in the same class in middle school."

"Right, right, I remember now, it rings a bell!" With this reminder, Li Guohong instantly recalled.

During the summer vacation, Li Luo had persuaded him and his wife to buy the apartment, saying that Shao Heqi's father had inside information.

Looking at it now, this information seemed quite credible!

Thinking of this, Li Guohong also smiled and shook the man's hand firmly, unable to stop himself from saying, "Ah, we also heard a little something. We had to buy an apartment for our child anyway, so we thought we'd give it a shot."

Listening to the two parents' conversation, the others immediately forgot all about the breakfast shop and eagerly joined the discussion.

Shao Heqi's father wasn't worried about the news spreading.

After all, Yuhang City had indeed issued a specific document, but it was still in the proposal draft stage and hadn't been fully implemented.

But it was a very likely possibility.

According to his estimate, the news would probably be confirmed by the end of the year at the earliest, or by the middle of next year at the latest.

In any case, his family had already bought the apartment they needed, so he didn't mind doing someone a favor at no cost to himself.

With more people buying property here, the housing prices might get hyped up even faster.

With that, the conversation here grew even more heated, to the point where Zhang Xuefen was left standing on the side, a look of bewilderment on her face.

How did this turn into a real estate discussion?

The key question was, were they really building a subway near No. 1 Affiliated High School?

Zhang Xuefen's expression turned ugly.

Regardless of Li Guohong's family situation, if this news was true, Zhang Xuefen's family didn't have much spare cash at the moment.

After Wei Dongrong had raised the funds, his real estate project was already under construction in full swing.

How could there be any spare money to invest in property?

Fortunately, this casual chat only lasted for a short while. As the tour proceeded to the observation of club activities, the parents' attention was gradually drawn back.

At each club they visited, parents would almost always spot their own child and would then smile and share with the parents next to them.

When Zhang Xuefen followed the group to the Calligraphy Club, she saw her son, Wei Chun, hunched over his desk, writing with a serious expression.

This was clearly a moment to show off, but for some reason, she got angry just looking at Wei Chun now.

Why couldn't her son be more competitive and also get 27th place in the whole school to make her proud?

In the end, it was still because he wasn't working hard enough!

She had been hesitant before about whether to enroll Wei Chun in extra tutoring classes. Now it seemed she couldn't afford to save that money.

As Zhang Xuefen thought this, she was already considering canceling Wei Chun's weekend calligraphy class and using the time on Saturday evening and Sunday morning to sign him up for a few tutoring subjects.

Of course, Wei Chun in the classroom was unaware of these thoughts.

He simply lowered his head even further after spotting his mother's figure, working hard at writing on the rice paper.

Only after the group of parents had left did Wei Chun let out a long breath and wipe the sweat from his forehead.

As time went on, the tour of all the club activities in the academic building was completed.

The parents then went to the sports field to observe athletic clubs like the Basketball Club, Table Tennis Club, and Badminton Club.

Watching the children release their energy on the field, the parents also felt a bit younger themselves.

And as they crossed the field and arrived at the entrance of the gymnasium, Xiuxiu, who was at the front, smiled and announced:

"Next up is our final stop for today."

"At our school, there's another club called the Rock Club. The students in it are each skilled in different instruments, and they work together seamlessly to form a school band."

"Today, they have prepared for a long time and will present a wonderful performance for all you uncles and aunties."

"Oh, right."

As Xiuxiu spoke, she inserted an exclusive piece of news for Class 8, "There are five members in the Rock Club's band this time, and two of them are students from our class."

Hearing this, Li Guohong felt a wave of emotion.

The students of No. 1 Affiliated High School were really something else.

They not only excelled academically but also had a rich variety of interests and talents.

In comparison, although his family's Li Luo's grades had improved, in terms of special talents... hmm... he wondered if writing web novels counted as one?

But just as Li Guohong was thinking this, Xiuxiu continued, "One of these two students is our class's sports representative, Yan Zhusheng, who is the lead singer."

"As for the other one," Xiuxiu's gaze shifted to Li Guohong, and then she said with a smile, "it's our class president, Li Luo. He's on guitar."

As soon as these words came out, Li Guohong was momentarily stunned.

And beside him, Yuan Wanqing raised her eyebrows, a trace of interest finally appearing on her face.

(End of Chapter)
